tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search open remote job listings aggregated from many job boards and company career pages, deduplicated. Use eligibleFrom to keep only jobs open to applicants in a given country, and overlapWith to rank by working-hours overlap with the applicant's time zone. Reposts by other job aggregators are hidd

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get one job listing by its ID (from search_jobs): company, location, salary, remote policy, tags and the URL of the original posting. The full description lives at that URL.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List job categories with their IDs, for the categoryId filter of search_jobs and get_salary_insights.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List the skill and technology tags used on job listings (e.g. React, Python, Figma) with their IDs.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Get a company's profile by slug (from list_companies): open remote job count, top categories and tags.

tools.name: list_companies
tools.description: List companies with open remote jobs, optionally filtered by name; returns slugs for get_company.

tools.name: get_statistics
tools.description: Aggregate statistics for the remote job market right now: open job counts, salary figures and trends.

tools.name: get_salary_insights
tools.description: Advertised salary ranges for remote jobs by category (USD), optionally for one category.
